Healthcare technology, digital health, or patient-facing application experience is strongly preferred. Candidates should have hands-on experience managing mobile product features and collaborating with engineering and design teams to deliver high-quality iOS and Android experiences. Why PsychPlus? The current delivery model for mental health care is broken in this country. At PsychPlus, we set out on a mission to reimagine how mental health care is delivered to every American. Our goal is to provide a digital-first, modern approach to psychiatry and therapy that makes care more accessible, affordable, and convenient. We provide care both in person at our offices across Texas and virtually, giving patients greater flexibility in how they access mental health services. By combining exceptional clinical care with best-in-class technology, we are building an integrated care experience designed around the needs of patients and providers. Our digital products play an important role in this mission. From helping patients navigate their care journey to making appointments, accessing relevant services, and engaging with their care teams, we believe technology should make getting mental health care easier—not more complicated. Join us in building intuitive, reliable, and patient-centered mobile experiences that help remove barriers to care and support our mission of making quality mental health services accessible to everyone. About the Role We’re looking for a Product Owner – Mobile Applications to own the roadmap, feature prioritization, and delivery of PsychPlus's mobile application experiences. In this role, you will help shape how patients interact with PsychPlus through mobile technology, making it easier for them to access services, manage appointments, navigate their care journey, and engage with the platform. You will work closely with mobile engineering, UX/UI design, QA, product leadership, clinical operations, and other cross-functional stakeholders to translate business objectives and user needs into intuitive, scalable, and reliable mobile solutions. From onboarding and registration to appointment scheduling, reminders, virtual care access, and ongoing patient engagement, you will help optimize the end-to-end mobile experience. You will also drive improvements based on user feedback, product analytics, usability insights, and evolving business priorities. The ideal candidate combines strong product ownership skills with a deep understanding of mobile application development, user experience, and Agile delivery. Experience in healthcare technology, telehealth, or patient-facing digital platforms is a strong advantage, particularly for candidates who understand the importance of privacy, reliability, accessibility, and trust in healthcare applications. If you’re passionate about building impactful mobile products and using technology to make mental health care more accessible, we’d love to meet you. Responsibilities Own the mobile product roadmap: Define and manage the mobile application roadmap, feature priorities, and development backlog in alignment with PsychPlus's business objectives and patient experience goals. Drive the patient mobile experience: Identify opportunities to make it easier for patients to discover services, register, manage appointments, access relevant care resources, and navigate their mental healthcare journey. Manage end-to-end mobile workflows: Partner with stakeholders to improve onboarding, account registration, profile management, appointment booking and management, appointment reminders, virtual care access, and other relevant patient-facing workflows. Translate requirements into actionable deliverables: Convert business objectives, user feedback, and stakeholder needs into clear user stories, functional requirements, acceptance criteria, and workflow documentation. Partner with mobile engineering teams: Work closely with iOS, Android, and cross-platform developers to evaluate technical feasibility, clarify requirements, resolve dependencies, and deliver high-quality mobile features. Champion user-centered design: Collaborate with UX/UI designers to develop intuitive, accessible, and consistent mobile experiences that reduce friction and make navigating mental healthcare simpler for patients. Optimize mobile usability: Identify opportunities to simplify navigation, reduce unnecessary steps, improve onboarding completion, and create a seamless experience across supported devices and platforms. Lead Agile product execution: Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and product demonstrations to maintain alignment and ensure delivery against priorities. Drive quality and release readiness: Partner with Engineering and QA to validate requirements, prioritize defects, coordinate acceptance testing, and ensure features meet quality expectations before release. Manage mobile releases: Support app release planning, version updates, feature rollouts, release communications, and post-launch monitoring across the relevant mobile platforms. Monitor product performance: Use product analytics, user feedback, engagement trends, and adoption metrics to identify friction points and inform roadmap decisions. Improve patient engagement: Evaluate opportunities to improve user activation, appointment completion, return usage, and engagement with relevant mobile features. Coordinate push notifications and in-app communications: Work with relevant stakeholders to improve reminders, notifications, and other timely communications that support the patient experience, while respecting user preferences and applicable requirements. Ensure privacy, security, and accessibility: Partner with engineering and compliance stakeholders to ensure mobile features account for healthcare privacy requirements, appropriate data handling, security, and applicable accessibility standards. Manage cross-functional dependencies: Align product requirements and delivery plans across mobile engineering, backend services, design, QA, clinical operations, and other teams involved in the patient journey. Drive continuous improvement: Gather post-release feedback, evaluate feature performance, and identify enhancements that improve reliability, usability, and the overall PsychPlus mobile experience. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, Product Management, or a related field; equivalent practical experience may be considered. Demonstrated experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, Business Analyst, or in a similar product-focused role involving mobile applications. Hands-on experience managing mobile application features from requirements gathering and prioritization through development, testing, release, and post-launch optimization. Understanding of mobile application development and the product lifecycle for iOS and Android platforms. Experience translating business objectives and user needs into user stories, acceptance criteria, functional requirements, and actionable product backlogs. Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and product delivery tools such as Jira and Confluence. Experience collaborating with engineering, UX/UI design, QA, and cross-functional business stakeholders. Strong understanding of mobile usability, navigation, onboarding, user journeys, and the principles of user-centered product design. Familiarity with mobile app testing, defect prioritization, release readiness, and production issue management. Ability to use user feedback and product performance metrics to identify opportunities and support data-informed prioritization. Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills. Ability to balance user needs, business goals, technical constraints, and delivery timelines in a fast-paced environment. Understanding of mobile application privacy, security, and accessibility considerations. Preferred Qualifications Experience in healthcare technology, digital health, telehealth, behavioral health, mental health, or patient-facing mobile applications. Familiarity with patient engagement workflows, appointment scheduling, provider discovery, virtual care, and healthcare service navigation. Experience building mobile experiences that support both in-person and virtual healthcare delivery. Familiarity with mobile analytics platforms and tools used to measure onboarding completion, activation, engagement, retention, conversion, and feature adoption. Experience with push notifications, deep linking, in-app messaging, app permissions, and mobile engagement strategies. Familiarity with App Store and Google Play release processes, application reviews, version management, and production monitoring. Experience collaborating with native iOS and Android teams or cross-platform development teams using frameworks such as React Native or Flutter. Familiarity with tools such as Figma, Miro, Mixpanel, Firebase Analytics, or similar product design and analytics platforms. Understanding of healthcare privacy and security requirements, including HIPAA, and experience working with compliance stakeholders. Experience in a high-growth health technology company or a product-led digital business. What Success Looks Like Successful feature delivery: Prioritized mobile features are delivered on schedule with clear requirements, defined acceptance criteria, and effective cross-functional coordination. Improved patient onboarding: More users successfully complete registration and onboarding with fewer abandoned steps and less friction. Better access to care: Patients can navigate relevant services and manage their appointments through a clear, convenient mobile experience. Higher engagement and adoption: More users adopt relevant mobile features, supported by measurable improvements in activation, engagement, and retention. Improved usability: User feedback demonstrates that the application is intuitive, accessible, and easy to navigate. Reliable mobile performance: Reduced crash rates, critical defects, and recurring user-reported issues across supported devices and platforms. Effective product decisions: Product analytics, user research, and stakeholder feedback inform prioritization and continuous improvement. A better patient experience: Mobile product enhancements contribute to a smoother, more convenient journey for patients accessing mental health services through PsychPlus. So—What Do You Think? If you've made it this far, we're excited that you're considering joining PsychPlus. We're working to solve one of the most important challenges in healthcare: making quality mental health care more accessible and affordable. As a growing company, we value ownership, accountability, collaboration, and the ability to turn complex challenges into practical solutions. We move quickly, adapt as we learn, and expect our team members to take initiative, think critically, and collaborate across functions. You may be required to wear multiple hats, navigate ambiguity, and balance immediate delivery needs with longer-term product improvements. This role offers an opportunity to directly influence how patients experience mental healthcare through mobile technology. Your work will help shape the digital touchpoints that connect patients with services, simplify their care journey, and make accessing mental health support more convenient. At PsychPlus, we believe technology should make quality care easier to access. When we build better digital experiences, we help patients take the next step in their mental healthcare journey. We're excited to continue transforming mental health care together.

review_candidates.description: About the Job This role requires hands-on experience with Electronic Health Records (EHR/EMR) systems or healthcare technology. The current delivery model for mental health care is broken in this country. At PsychPlus, we are on a mission to reimagine how mental health care is delivered to every American by making it more accessible, affordable, and convenient. We are building a modern, digital-first approach to psychiatry and therapy, combining exceptional clinical care with best-in-class technology. With in-person care available across our Texas locations and virtual care options that allow patients to access services conveniently, we are creating an integrated care experience designed around the needs of patients, providers, and care teams. Technology is central to this mission. We believe that better clinical systems and streamlined workflows can empower providers to spend less time navigating administrative complexity and more time delivering high-quality mental health care. Join us in building technology that supports our clinicians, improves the patient experience, and helps make quality mental health care accessible to everyone. About the Role We’re looking for a Product Owner – Clinical to own and evolve the clinical product experience at PsychPlus. This role will focus on building and improving the workflows and capabilities that support our psychiatry and therapy services across in-person and virtual care settings. You will work closely with clinicians, clinical operations, engineering, design, QA, and other cross-functional teams to translate real-world clinical needs into intuitive, scalable, and reliable product solutions. From patient intake and clinical assessments to treatment planning, documentation, medication-related workflows, and care coordination, you will help ensure our clinical technology supports the day-to-day needs of providers and care teams. The ideal candidate understands the complexities of US healthcare and behavioral health workflows, has hands-on experience with EHR/EMR systems, and can bridge the gap between clinical operations and technical execution. You should be comfortable translating complex workflows into clear requirements, prioritizing product enhancements, and driving features from discovery through delivery and continuous improvement. Translate clinical needs into product requirements: Convert clinical, operational, and business requirements into detailed user stories, functional specifications, acceptance criteria, and workflow documentation. Improve the EHR/EMR experience: Identify opportunities to simplify clinical documentation, reduce duplicate data entry, improve information accessibility, and streamline provider workflows within the PsychPlus clinical platform. Champion provider and patient experience: Use stakeholder interviews, user feedback, workflow analysis, and usability testing to identify friction points and drive meaningful product improvements. Support clinical quality and compliance: Partner with relevant clinical and compliance stakeholders to ensure product requirements account for patient safety, privacy, security, and applicable healthcare regulations, including HIPAA. Drive product releases: Coordinate requirements readiness, acceptance testing, release planning, stakeholder communication, and rollout activities for new clinical features and enhancements. Measure product performance: Track feature adoption, workflow efficiency, user satisfaction, and recurring pain points to evaluate product impact and identify opportunities for improvement. Maintain clinical product documentation: Keep product requirements, workflow diagrams, business rules, user stories, and acceptance criteria clear, accurate, and accessible to cross-functional teams. Continuously improve the platform: Stay informed about behavioral health technology, EHR/EMR capabilities, clinical workflow best practices, and evolving healthcare requirements to help guide product decisions. Demonstrated experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, Business Analyst, or in a similar product-focused role within healthcare technology. Hands-on experience with EHR/EMR systems or clinical software is required. Strong understanding of US healthcare workflows, preferably within behavioral health, psychiatry, therapy, or outpatient clinical care. Experience gathering requirements from clinical users and translating complex workflows into clear product specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Working knowledge of clinical workflows such as patient intake, clinical assessments, encounter documentation, treatment planning, follow-up care, and care coordination. Experience managing product backlogs, prioritizing requirements, and collaborating with engineering and design teams to deliver software features. Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and product delivery tools such as Jira and Confluence. Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to communicate effectively with both clinical and technical teams and translate between clinical terminology and technical requirements. Understanding of healthcare privacy, security, and regulatory considerations, including HIPAA. Ability to manage competing priorities, navigate ambiguity, and deliver in a fast-paced, high-growth healthcare technology environment. Preferred Qualifications Experience building or managing products for behavioral health, mental health, psychiatry, therapy, telehealth, or digital health platforms. Experience supporting both in-person and virtual care delivery workflows. Familiarity with psychiatric and therapy practice workflows, including initial evaluations, progress notes, treatment plans, follow-up visits, and provider documentation. Exposure to healthcare interoperability standards and integrations, including HL7, FHIR, and other relevant healthcare data exchange standards. Experience working with clinical operations, licensed providers, multidisciplinary care teams, and healthcare compliance stakeholders. Familiarity with product analytics and feedback tools used to measure feature adoption, user engagement, and workflow performance. Experience using Figma, Miro, or similar tools to document workflows, map user journeys, and collaborate on product design. Experience in a high-growth health technology company or a product-led healthcare organization. What Success Looks Like Improved clinical efficiency: Providers can complete essential clinical tasks with fewer unnecessary steps and less administrative friction. Better provider experience: Clinical users report improved usability, clearer workflows, and greater confidence in the platform. Successful product delivery: Prioritized clinical features are delivered with well-defined requirements, clear acceptance criteria, and effective cross-functional coordination. Increased feature adoption: New clinical capabilities are adopted by providers and care teams and contribute to measurable workflow improvements. Reliable clinical workflows: Product enhancements support consistent documentation, effective care coordination, and appropriate handling of clinical information. Continuous product improvement: User feedback, product performance, and evolving clinical needs inform ongoing prioritization and roadmap decisions. Alignment with the PsychPlus mission: Product improvements help clinicians focus on delivering quality care and support a more accessible, convenient mental health care experience. So—What Do You Think? If you’ve made it this far, we’re excited that you’re considering joining PsychPlus. At PsychPlus, we’re working to solve one of the most important challenges in healthcare: making quality mental health care more accessible and affordable. We’re a growing company that values ownership, accountability, collaboration, and the ability to turn complex problems into practical solutions. We move quickly, adapt as we learn, and expect our team members to take initiative, think critically, and work across functions to get things done. You may need to wear multiple hats, navigate ambiguity, and balance immediate delivery needs with long-term product improvements. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact on the technology that clinicians use to care for patients every day. Your work will help improve clinical workflows, strengthen the provider experience, and contribute to our mission of transforming mental health care. At PsychPlus, we believe that when our clinicians are better supported, our patients benefit. We’re excited to build that future together.

review_candidates.title: Pricing & Margin Analyst
review_candidates.description: About the client Our client is a fast-growing logistics technology company helping modern brands streamline their international supply chain. They are scaling rapidly and building a best-in-class Revenue Operations function to support Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, and Customer Success. Overview Every merchant deal is priced from a multi-part cost stack: air freight, duties and customs, pick & pack, and last-mile carriers that vary by weight, zone, lane, and product type. As Pricing & Margin Analyst, you will own that process end to end: building price cards for new deals and then checking that actual results match what was priced. This is a hands-on individual contributor role, not a management role. You will be the bridge between the North American Sales team and the operations team in China, speeding up a process that is currently slow and back-and-forth. A pricing process and a large base of materials already exist (about 10 carriers, each with around 10 lines, and 100+ price cards). You will learn them quickly, validate them, and improve them. You will report to the COO, with a weekly check-in and otherwise a self-directed way of working. Responsibilities Build standard and custom price cards for new deals at target margin, working from the Sales request queue in Jira. Determine which carrier and line applies to each product and destination, including restricted items (e.g., batteries, knives), weight divisors, zones, and footnotes in carrier rate sheets. Join calls with Sales to understand what they need, and with the China team to confirm what can ship on which line and at what cost. Model non-standard setups such as direct injection, bonded US inventory, new origin countries, and large accounts with unusual product profiles. Investigate margin drops or gaps between actuals and the model (price card changes, weight mix, carrier, zone, surcharges) and recommend fixes. Model peak-season surcharges and pricing scenarios that Sales can take to merchants. Validate models against raw billing and shipment data, and confirm assumptions with the China operations and finance teams. Identify structural margin improvements, such as carrier mix, minimum weights, and pricing structure. Flag deals that don't work at the proposed numbers and show the math. Final decisions on major pricing and discount questions rest with the COO and leadership. Must-have skills Ideally 7+ years of experience in pricing, financial analysis, or a related field, with a preference for people who enjoy doing the work themselves rather than managing others. Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills and solid unit economics modeling. Building a price from a cost stack and knowing what moves margin matters more than advanced math. Clear communicator in writing and on calls, able to explain a margin result to a salesperson in two minutes and write questions the China team can answer in one reply. Persistent and responsive. Keeps asking until the numbers tie out to source data, is not afraid to be "annoying" in the right way, and closes loops without being chased. Good instinct for spotting when numbers look off. Comfortable with messy data (carrier rate sheets in Excel, incomplete billing exports, Slack threads), and able to state assumptions instead of waiting for perfect data. Uses AI tools such as Claude daily, and verifies the output against raw data and common sense before sharing it. Able to deliver a range with clear assumptions on time, then tighten it. Willing to push back on Sales or senior leaders when the numbers don't support a deal. Professional English, written and spoken. Nice-to-have skills Experience in logistics, freight forwarding, 3PL, or e-commerce shipping (weight tiers, dimensional weight, zones, last-mile carriers, duties) Deal desk or pricing experience at a B2B services company, working with Sales on live deals SQL (BigQuery and Metabase are a plus) Mandarin Tools: Google Sheets, Excel, BigQuery, Metabase, Jira, Slack, Claude Schedule: Full-time, remote. You can be based anywhere in the world. About 5 to 6 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern business hours. Most days, about 1 hour of overlap with the China team, which may mean an early-morning or evening call. Some team members split their day (for example, an early call with China, a break, then the US afternoon). Perks 10 days of paid time off plus holidays Fully remote, work from anywhere
